<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>NSE IPO update:</strong> The National Stock Exchange has revised its draft filing with SEBI, reducing its proposed IPO size to Rs 23,500 crore.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market performance:</strong> Indian indices rebounded to close higher, led by gains in banking heavyweights like HDFC and Axis Bank, successfully shrugging off earlier volatility caused by rising crude oil prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Crude oil and currency impact:</strong> Brent crude prices crossing the $100 per barrel threshold and rising US bond yields have pressured the Indian Rupee, which recently slipped toward the 95 level against the US Dollar.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
</ul>
